summary: Viomi Technology filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on October 9, 2026, disclosing board changes via Exhibit 99.1. The Board appointed Mr. Xinlang Yu, Deputy General Manager of Xiaomi Corporation's Ecosystem Department, as a director effective that same day, replacing Mr. Qian Sun, who resigned for personal reasons. No stake, price, premium, or transaction terms were stated, and no advisor or board recommendation was disclosed. The change is an ordinary board succession tied to the Xiaomi relationship rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure; nothing suggests a special-situation event. What to watch: any follow-on filings indicating broader ownership or governance changes between Xiaomi and Viomi.
